headline: Saudi Crown Prince invites PM Tarique Rahman to visit Saudi Arabia
summary: The invitation was delivered by the Saudi Ambassador to Bangladesh, Abdullah Jafar bin Abi Ayah, during a meeting at the Prime Minister's Office.
details: Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud has officially invited Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to visit Saudi Arabia.
The invitation was handed over by the Saudi Ambassador to Bangladesh, Abdullah Jafar bin Abi Ayah, during a meeting at the Prime Minister's Office in the Secretariat on Monday.
The visit is expected to focus on strengthening bilateral ties and enhancing cooperation between the two nations.
The meeting was attended by Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman and Foreign Affairs Advisor Humayun Kabir.
caption:
A major diplomatic move as Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince invites PM Tarique Rahman for an official visit.

Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud has officially invited Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to visit Saudi Arabia.

The invitation was handed over by the Saudi Ambassador to Bangladesh, Abdullah Jafar bin Abi Ayah, during a meeting at the Prime Minister's Office in the Secretariat on Monday.

The visit is expected to focus on strengthening bilateral ties and enhancing cooperation between the two nations.

The meeting was attended by Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman and Foreign Affairs Advisor Humayun Kabir.

headline: Govt to abolish RAB, replace with SRB
summary: The government has finalized a draft to dissolve the Rapid Action Battalion and establish the Special Security Bureau (SRB) in its place.
details: The government has finalized a draft proposal to abolish the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB), one of the country's most prominent elite forces.
The proposed replacement for RAB will be the Special Security Bureau (SRB), which will take over its roles and responsibilities.
This move comes as part of a broader restructuring of the security apparatus to ensure better governance and accountability.
The draft has received final approval, marking a significant shift in the national security framework of Bangladesh.
caption:
RAB is set to be abolished. A new force, the SRB, will take its place.

The government has finalized a draft proposal to abolish the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB), one of the country's most prominent elite forces.

The proposed replacement for RAB will be the Special Security Bureau (SRB), which will take over its roles and responsibilities.

This move comes as part of a broader restructuring of the security apparatus to ensure better governance and accountability.

The draft has received final approval, marking a significant shift in the national security framework of Bangladesh.
